message: Додай ще одну модель до всіх налаштувань - GPT-6 Sol.
scope_note: Authorize the repository change that adds GPT-6 Sol as an optional Codex model in Head/specialist and Critic Settings, validates catalog-backed model/effort choices, preserves existing defaults and accepted snapshots, updates tests and reconciles SDD artifacts. This does not authorize deployment, a hosted database migration, a live provider turn or changes to external services.
